_comment: MCP configuration for the unattended recognition run (scripts/recognize_requested.sh).
1. INTAKE_ONLY_REQUESTED=1 is set inside the server process, so intake_pending returns ONLY items
the user flagged with the 'Recognize' button, whatever the model asks for.
2. There is no partdb server here. Together with --strict-mcp-config the run cannot touch the
inventory at all, neither for reading nor for writing.
If bom-agent runs on another machine, put ["ssh", "user@host", "docker", ...] in front.
